scope.reference_release: PDG 2025 update tables and individually cited reviews, accessed on the snapshot date.
scope.elementary_coverage: Six quark flavors and antiparticles; three charged leptons and antiparticles; three active neutrino flavor sectors and antineutrino labels; photon; one gluon octet; W plus, W minus, Z and Higgs bosons.
scope.field_coverage: Standard Model field families and classical geometry; inferred dark-sector categories and project hypotheses are distinguished.
scope.selected_composites: Proton, neutron and their antiparticles have individual entries.
scope.composite_and_collective_completeness: Non-exhaustive families, not every hadron, resonance, nuclide, atom, ion, molecule, material phase or excited state.
scope.interaction_completeness: Major families and representative channels, not every allowed mode or contribution.
scope.numerical_role: External reference targets, without simulator calibration or update selection.
scope.channel_multiplicity: Repeated IDs denote separate participants of the same species.
scope.property_references: An entity_id within a property refers to the same property on that entity. A metadata_key refers to a current-entity intrinsic attribute.
scope.field_link_semantics: Particle and field links are reciprocal excitation links. Composites identify constituents instead; family field_ids identify underlying fields.

notes: Descriptive reference data only: no executable profiles, formulas, transition rates or update rules.
Reference facts and possible products do not derive dynamics; laws need independent evidence from basic conditions.
Electric charges use thirds of positive elementary charge; twice_spin stores doubled intrinsic spin.
Decimal strings preserve published facts without simulator conversion. Unknown, not applicable, theoretical zero and upper bound are distinct.
Neutrino flavor states are not mass eigenstates; their paired labels do not decide Dirac or Majorana nature.
The gluon denotes one adjoint octet, not independent scalar laws or additional antiparticle species.
Antimatter has positive mass. Anticolor is a conjugate representation, not electric-like negative charge.
Possible channels require suitable states and applicable energy, momentum, angular momentum and charge conditions.
Rest mass and particle count are not universal reaction invariants. Products carry the applicable conserved quantities.
Evidence statuses separate measurements, theoretical classifications, unknown identity and hypotheses.

interaction_families.label: Electromagnetic scattering
conditions: Charged elementary sectors couple directly; neutral composites respond through internal charge and moments.
Neutrality does not establish complete electromagnetic transparency.

interaction_families.label: Radiation and electromagnetic transitions
conditions: States and environment must permit emission or absorption and full energy-momentum exchange.
A photon product does not license free-particle radiation in empty space.

interaction_families.label: Production and annihilation
conditions: Initial energy, momentum and quantum numbers must permit the products.
Annihilation leaves products; one real photon cannot create a massive pair in empty space.

interaction_families.label: Strong color interactions
conditions: Quark color and gluon self-interactions belong to the non-Abelian strong sector.
Partonic labels do not claim isolated colored asymptotic particles.

interaction_families.label: Hadron formation and binding
conditions: Nonperturbative binding and sea components contribute.
Valence identities determine neither mass nor confinement dynamics.
Top quarks decay before ordinary hadron formation; a top-sector label does not assert a stable top hadron.

interaction_families.label: Weak charged-current interactions and decays
conditions: Chiral representations, flavor mixing and available states constrain channels.
Particle, hadron and nuclear decays require their corresponding physical initial states.

interaction_families.label: Weak neutral-current interactions and decays
conditions: Coupling is not determined by electric charge alone.
A flavor label does not permit arbitrary flavor-changing neutral currents.

interaction_families.label: Electroweak gauge-boson interactions
conditions: Charged weak bosons participate in electromagnetic and weak gauge interactions.
Allowed polarizations and sufficient collision energy are required.

interaction_families.label: Higgs interactions and decays
conditions: Massive charged fermions and weak bosons have Higgs-sector couplings.
Photon and gluon channels involve virtual particles, not direct tree-level couplings.
Neutrino mass generation remains model dependent.

interaction_families.label: Higgs self-interaction
conditions: Standard Model self-interaction, without claiming a directly measured full self-coupling structure.

interaction_families.label: Neutrino flavor conversion
conditions: Flavor states coherently mix propagation mass states.
Conversion is not one-particle decay or exact lepton-flavor conservation.

interaction_families.label: Gravity and gravitational radiation
conditions: Classical coupling concerns energy, momentum and stress, including radiation.
Metric and wave observations do not establish gravitons or the computational hypothesis.
Dark-sector links retain unresolved microscopic identities.

interaction_families.label: Nuclear reactions and radioactive transitions
conditions: Composition, state and energetics constrain capture, emission, fusion, fission and decay.
An effective combination of strong, electromagnetic and weak processes, not another fundamental force.

interaction_families.label: Atomic and molecular binding and transitions
conditions: Electronic and rovibrational states, charge and environment identify the transition.
Binding, ionization, recombination and dissociation are state-specific.

interaction_families.label: Collective interactions in matter
conditions: Medium and state define effective excitations and couplings.
No additional fundamental forces or universal material constants are introduced.

interaction_families.label: Proposed computation-field relationship
conditions: Only the identified Universe24 postulates define the proposed relationship.
No measured coupling or derived gravity law is established.

conditions: A quantum-gravity candidate is required; graviton existence and interaction laws are not experimentally established.
